name: Reference-Derived Stick Animation DNA V3

reference_policy.allowed: extract transferable pacing, composition, motion, joke structure, camera grammar, prop logic, and scene mechanics
reference_policy.disallowed: copy exact creator characters, trace frames, reuse logos/signature costume details, duplicate signature jokes, or recreate a source shot-for-shot
reference_policy.output_requirement: original Content Control character identity with reference-derived mechanics

scene_rule: Every beat must change at least two of: character pose, prop state, camera, environment, scale, spatial relationship.

educational_embedding.math_visualization: show arithmetic as an object interaction or physical transformation

anti_slideshow: no narration over unchanged composition longer than 1 second
no character standing idle while captions advance
